import sys
import math

data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
if not data:
    sys.exit()

a = float(data[0])
b = float(data[1])
c = float(data[2])

discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c

if discriminant < 0:
    print("No real roots")
else:
    sqrt_d = math.sqrt(discriminant)
    x1 = (-b + sqrt_d) / (2 * a)
    x2 = (-b - sqrt_d) / (2 * a)
    
    if x1 > x2:
        x1, x2 = x2, x1
    
    print(f"{x1:.2f}")
    print(f"{x2:.2f}")
